parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

serious: high

suspicious: medium

remind: low
parameters.help_zh:
威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
serious：高危
suspicious：中危
remind：低危
parameters.name: threat_level

parameters.help_en: The rule name. The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称, 仅支持字母、数字、下划线、点
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:

predefine: predefined

customize: custom
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。 取值：
predefine：预定义
customize：自定义
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The event generation method. Valid values:

default: the default built-in method

singleToSingle: An event is generated for each alert.

allToSingle: An event is generated for all alerts in an epoch
parameters.help_zh:
事件生成方式。 取值：
default:默认内置方式
singleToSingle：每个告警生成一个事件
allToSingle：周期内告警生成一个事件
parameters.name: event_transfer_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule status. Valid values:

0: initial

10: testing with simulated data

15: testing with production data

20: testing with production data is complete

100: published
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。 取值：
0：初始状态
10：模拟数据测试
15：业务数据测试中
20：业务数据测试结束
100：规则上线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the rules by. Valid values:

GmtModified: Sorts by modification time.

Id: Sorts by rule ID. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
规则列表排列字段。 取值：
GmtModified：基于修改时间排序
Id：基于规则id排序（默认）
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

desc: descending

asc: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
事件列表排列方向。 取值：
desc：降序排列
asc：升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the perspective of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong)

ap-southeast-1: assets outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
